scope: Encrypted L2 transport (CanopusConnect) and the owner pump it rides on. Static recovery from the exact firmware IDB; the owner pump part was also run in Mirage.
constraints: Exact-image static recovery only; no production approval
Encrypted WearPacket L2 only; failed decryption never dispatches
Receive/transmit on the Bluetooth owner (the loop the SPP pty is read on); owner timer init/start on the native UI owner
SAR callback replacement only in RAM; no flash patching
No new threads or work queues

abi.rx: void(uint16_t handle, uint8_t channel, uint8_t opcode, void *payload, uint16_t len)
abi.crypto: int(void *session, int encrypt, uint16_t len, const void *in, void *out)
abi.list: head+4 prev link; node+12 connection; connection+12 RX callback
abi.packet: channel +0, opcode +1, payload +4, len +8, callbacks/cookies +12/+16/+20/+24 (28 bytes)
abi.owner_timer: 88-byte base uv_timer_t, 8-byte aligned; init/start only on owner task

evidence: miwear_main (sub_C383B24, string 'miwear_main') stores uv_default_loop() (sub_C1C3FA4) in dword_200A2B80, initializes a timer on it with sub_C1C0008 and runs it with uv_run (sub_C1BEDB0): the UI owner loop, as 0x20098D3C is on 3.1.32.
sub_C1C0008 is uv_timer_init(loop, timer): type 13 at +8, flags 8 at +44, loop at +4, handle queue at +16, cb/timeout/repeat cleared at +48/+64/+72 (3.1.32's layout, two stores reordered).

sub_C1C0142 is uv_timer_start(timer, cb, uint64 timeout, uint64 repeat): timeout +64, repeat +72, cb +48, heap node +52..+60, start id +80 (8 bytes) from loop+0x138, so an 88-byte handle. Its first 18 bytes match 3.1.32's sub_C1D3760.
UI code passes dword_200A2B80 as the loop: watchface get_free_disk (sub_C4ED824: uv_fs_statfs(dword_200A2B80, ..., "/data")).
TIMER / TIMER_DELETE are the target's lv_timer_create / lv_timer_del (FW_LV_TIMER_CREATE / FW_LV_TIMER_DEL).

RX sub_C59A6D8 is the SAR V2 TRANS L2 receive callback: session lookup first (sub_C59B6F4), opcode 2 decrypts with sub_C597F28(session, 0, len, payload, tmp), 'decrypt failed' returns without dispatching. Unlike 3.1.32 it also refuses unencrypted LYRA (8) and checks PB (1); the Supervisor forwards every channel it does not own to this callback unchanged.
SESSION sub_C59B6F4 walks the session list 0x20092644 comparing the uint16 handle at session+14.
CRYPTO sub_C597F28: same body as 3.1.32 sub_C556E6C (state+64, mutex +76, key state+16 for decrypt, AES-CTR sub_C1D8138).
SEND sub_C59A9E4 ('miwear_transport_send  channlel'): same packet fields; opcode 2 encrypts with sub_C597F28(encrypt=1) and submits through sub_C599C2C.

CONNECTIONS: SAR open sub_C59A094 allocates a 224-byte connection (3.1.32: 216) and links its 16-byte node at 0x20092620; node+12 = connection, connection+12 = arg3 is unchanged. The caller sub_C59AB70 passes RX sub_C59A6D8 as arg3.

BT_LOOP: Bluetooth runs as a separate bluetoothd task (service_loop); the SAR side runs in miwear_bluetooth_main (sub_C1D4EBC), which stores uv_default_loop() in dword_2009CEA0, inits its timers with sub_C1C0008/sub_C1C0142 and ends in uv_run(dword_2009CEA0). btport pty_open_callback sub_C1D3CCC opens the SPP pty with euv_pty_init(dword_2009CEA0, fd) and reads with sub_C1D6428, which feeds SAR receive sub_C59A918 -> sub_C59929C.
